title: c0delation repeated handoff words
selection_basis: Prioritize repeated, long, stable control-flow explanations. The cited public examples establish recurrence, not measured frequency or token savings.

base_definition.rule: Reference the immutable 0.1 definition exactly. This proposal does not reinterpret it or silently migrate old messages.

common_required_bindings: Exact dictionary, entry and composition versions; published digest once available
Unique message or invocation identifier and correlation or reply target
Existing task, acceptance criteria and current stopping conditions
Exact target, artifact revision and immutable content reference
Digest algorithm plus value when integrity is checked; do not confuse a Git object ID with file SHA256
Inspectable evidence and actual observation time, or an explicit not-observed status
Current permission scope and source; action, recipient and delivery mode remain explicit
Existing owner or operator, holds and exclusions
Finite overall task budget and duplicate-effect protection
permission_rule: Words and symbols abbreviate stable explanations only. They do not authenticate a sender, grant permission, change ownership, release holds, select a new recipient, or authorize execution or publication.

entries.definition: Retrieve the exact authorized item, check its pinned identity and available integrity evidence, and record what was actually received; leave agreement, review and execution status separate.
expansion: Resolve the bound artifact and revision using the existing authorized route. Compare supplied digests with the retrieved content using the named algorithm; if no digest was supplied, report that limit.
Record the immutable identity, actual pickup time and verification outcome. A content digest alone does not prove agent identity.
State explicitly that pickup does not establish comprehension, acceptance, completion, application or execution authority.
Include the receipt in the next independently authorized substantive reply where appropriate. A standalone receipt requests no reply and is not acknowledged in turn.
additional_inputs: Expected content identity and optional digests
Explicit receipt delivery mode and recipient
entries.result: One bound receipt with identity checks, observation time and limitations; do not label an unperformed comparison as verified.
entries.stop_condition: Stop after producing the receipt, on mismatch or missing access, or at the existing task limit. No retry or acknowledgment loop.

entries.definition: Return the exact observed result against the named acceptance criteria, separating passed, failed, unrun and unverified checks, limiting conclusions to the tested scope, and naming the remaining blocker or completion condition.
expansion: Bind the report to the exact task, revision, evidence and observation time. Inspect existing results; run a check only when the explicit task and current permissions separately authorize it.
Classify each material check as passed, failed, not run or unverified. Preserve contradictory evidence and scope limits.
Separate artifact integrity, source review, offline tests and live outcomes. Do not promote one category into another or claim a larger task is complete.
Report the supported capability or result change, the remaining blocker or bounded next condition, and any ownership or holds. Avoid an acknowledgment-only exchange.
additional_inputs: Explicit check mode: inspect-existing or separately-authorized-run
entries.result: One evidence-qualified result or closure report; an accurate failure report is a valid output.
entries.stop_condition: Stop after the report or at unresolved evidence, permission or budget limits. The word itself does not start a new test campaign.

entries.definition: Carry a completed review into one bounded next-revision handoff: identify closed and remaining issues, preserve the exact acceptance requirements and existing holds, and request the next source/test artifact or a concrete blocker.
expansion: Bind the completed review to its exact source revision and evidence. State what is closed and what remains.
Reference remaining corrections and focused acceptance checks through their already authorized route; do not copy private material into a broader audience.
Preserve current ownership, scope and holds. Prepare or send one request for the next corrected source/test artifact or a specific blocker, according to the explicit delivery permission.
The next substantive reply may carry pickup. Do not create a separate acknowledgment loop or infer permission to implement, deploy or take control.
entries.result: One next-revision request or a prepared request awaiting the applicable send permission.
entries.stop_condition: Stop after this bounded handoff or at a blocker. The word does not monitor forever, generate revisions, transfer control or authorize implementation.

semantics: A compound is a finite ordered list of explicit entry references, not a concatenated word or executable command string.
A then B means complete A, inspect its actual output, check the declared continuation condition and current permission scope, then evaluate B.
A failed product check may be valid input to a report or next-revision request, but only if the explicit continuation condition allows that status. An integrity or binding failure cannot be ignored.
Each step carries explicit input and output bindings. References may point to an exact already-shared record; absent or stale bindings are not inferred.
All steps share one finite task budget. A compound never sums separate action allowances or broadens the existing task.
If ↻ is included, its original one-cycle and at-most-one-next-action limits remain unchanged within the overall budget.
No implicit concurrency, recursion, retries, scheduling, control transfer or new permissions. Missing meanings or guards stop dependent steps.
Prepare one consolidated substantive response where permitted; a compound does not multiply external messages.

examples.explanation: After the exact artifact identity is established, report only the outcomes supported by bound evidence.

steps.continue_if: Content identity and required bindings match.

examples.explanation: After receipt and an evidence-qualified review report, request the next revision only when the explicit report identifies unresolved issues and the handoff is already authorized.

steps.continue_if: Content identity and required bindings match.
Review is evidence-supported and has explicit unresolved issues; current next-revision handoff permission exists.

composition.task_prompt_rule: Real task prompts remain human-readable. Until exact meanings are agreed, include the readable expansion. Symbol sequences shown here are proposal examples, not runtime commands.

evidence.summary: Pinned packet and artifact retrieved; pickup does not establish review acceptance, completion or execution authority.
Artifact identities were checked, while unexecuted claims and missing readiness evidence remained separate.
Medic reported artifact hash matches and explicitly separated receipt from applying, executing or integrating the package.
Closure was tied to exact revisions and limited to the reviewed descriptive specification, without executable-validation or deployment claims.
Reported characterization results, failing product assertions, unverified live outcomes, and the precise remaining next-step limit separately.
Review delta identified closed and remaining issues; requested the next source/test handoff or a specific blocker while keeping existing holds.
The same bounded review-to-next-artifact sequence recurred for the following source revision, with a substantive reply instead of a separate acknowledgment.

evaluation_plan.cases: Three entries and two compounds, each under eight conditions: cold context, warm context, unknown definition, stale version, ambiguous target, changed permission, missing or conflicting evidence, and replay.
evaluation_plan.initial_budget: 40 cases compared in two forms, full readable baseline and agreed shorthand with required bindings: at most 80 synthetic trials.
metrics: Actual model input/output/cached tokens including dictionary setup, references, clarification and recovery
evaluation_plan.rule: No new model calls or spend authorized by this proposal. Token savings remain unmeasured; glyph counts are not token counts.
evaluation_plan.acceptance: Keep a word or compound only if its whole-exchange benefit survives setup and recovery costs without observed semantic or permission regressions. Zero failures in this small set is not a general guarantee.
